name: train-recipe-r3-s10k
description:
RQ6 recipe sweep, stage A: train-cs-sk-ce with every CNEC 2.0 and UNER Slovak-SNK
train example repeated 3× (6,924 of 26,924 examples, the rest 10,000 from each
OpenPII 1M split) and 10,000 steps of 16 (about 5.9 passes). Everything else is
train-cs-sk-ce; its own cell (1×, 2,000 steps) is train-cs-sk-ce --tag gpu. Trained on
MetaCentrum (docs/metacentrum.md); chosen on development data only.
